services.name: Lake Leelanau 4 Hour Tour
services.desc: About Spend less time planning and more time enjoying! Explore the sandbars and great swimming spots on Lake Leelanau. If time permits, go ashore in the quaint towns of Lake Leelanau or historic Fish Town in Leland. We will customize your itinerary based on your interests and the weather conditions. This is a day to remember! services.name: Lake Leelanau 6 Hour Tour
services.desc: About Go ahead, take a full day off, you deserve it! During your trip we will explore the sandbars and great swimming spots on Lake Leelanau. Get off the boat and explore the towns of Lake Leelanau and Leland along the way. Walk one of the best beaches in Northern Michigan and play in the waves of Lake Michigan! Wine tasting, food, and drinks ashore are available. This is pure Michigan at its finest! services.name: 4 Hour Lake Discovery Tour
services.desc: About Have you always wanted to explore other inland lakes around Traverse City? Renting a lake house and want to get out on the water? H2Go Charters has you covered. We are licensed to operate on nearly every lake in Leelanau, Grand Traverse, and Antrim Counties. We can pick you up on these lakes or even your home or rental to give you a memorable day on the water. services.name: Captain for Hire
services.desc: Welcome aboard! Duration 4 Hours About H2GO Charters offers a Captain for Hire option for people who are renting a boat or who own a boat but want to leave the driving and trip planning to us! Captain Jeff is a USCG 50 Ton licensed captain with a sail endorsement. H2GO can meet you on any of the lakes (inland, Lake Michigan, and East/West Grand Traverse Bays) in the Traverse City and surrounding areas.
